## When to use

### 4. `templates/chota-angular-ngrx/src/ui/templates/Layout/Layout.stories.ts`
Created to provide the story definition for the Layout component, including a `Layout` story with a `children` prop.

### 5. `templates/chota-react-redux/AGENTS.md`
Created to provide the agent configuration for the React + Redux template. It includes the required sections (`## Architecture`, `## Skills`, `## Commands`, `## Build a todo app`) and links 8 existing skills from the `skills/` directory.

### 6. `templates/chota-react-rtk/AGENTS.md`
Created to provide the agent configuration for the React + RTK template. It includes the required sections and links 8 existing skills.

### 7. `templates/chota-react-saga/AGENTS.md`

### 8. `templates/chota-react-zustand/AGENTS.md`

### 9. `templates/chota-vue-pinia/AGENTS.md`
Created to provide the agent configuration for the Vue + Pinia template. It includes the required sections and links 8 existing skills.

### 10. `templates/chota-wc-saga/AGENTS.md`
Created to provide the agent configuration for the Vanilla + Saga template. It includes the required sections and links 8 existing skills.
